review.title: Nitrogen-removal, GAC enrichment and QY2S1: scoped genus-reference diagnostics
review.independence_basis: Parent independently read the retained primary-source context, full authored source config, native results, all three candidate diffs and exact external candidate/receipt hashes before application. The shared engine, binder, gate runner and review builder were independently reviewed with mutation controls. This is self-review of the resulting bounded technical corrections.
review.summary: Six selected taxonomy occurrences in three whole records now have native genus-reference correspondences and grounding statuses. All existing biological claims, stock/MAG uncertainty, unselected mappings and alternatives, quotations, scientific findings and old history remain unchanged. Actual M5 application and eight scoped native commands per record are separately bound.
review.scope_description: Exactly the declared genus-reference fields/statuses, native appended events and actual application/source/validation provenance for three records. This is not a new full scientific assessment or a claim that the original experiments establish reference-genome identity.
review.selection: Three source-reviewed whole records CommunityMech:000372, CommunityMech:000349 and CommunityMech:000424. The first actual372 application and all eight commands were verified before349 and424 followed serially through the same path. Exactly six selected taxonomy occurrences are assessed; all unselected biological content is preserved.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Database correspondence and scoped gates do not complete whole-record scientific review, source-snippet validation, generated-page integration, the repair campaign or final corpus QC.

Native denominators are named-binomial reference populations under the exact761d5537 crosswalk, not genomes sequenced from the study stocks or MAGs. Klebsiella44527/44529 has two GTDB genera despite a displayed rounded fraction1.0; unanimity must not be inferred. Lentimicrobium3/3 is a thin reference population.

The nitrogen-removal primary evidence here is retained abstract text; the GAC and QY2S1 sources are selected retained main-text passages. This bounded pass performs no new complete-paper, supplement, figure, strain sequence or assembly audit. Separate supplementary-reference mismatches remain owned by1996.

The whole-record native route report ran locally at1d5bfe5a, source binding/staging at295c7d2b, and actual guarded application/checks on isolated M5 at23d84a2d. Local native Python was3.13.12 and M5 native Python3.13.2. Post-application checks are not a clean-tree run. File mtime in mapping_source is not a database release; local NCBI identity/rank observations are stat-bound, not a full database checksum.

372 retains unknown strain identities, nitrate removal versus total nitrogen-removal distinctions, FeII/PAM conditions, and every Stutzerimonas/Pseudomonas alternative. Reference correspondence does not establish species, assemblies, cross-feeding or a nitrogen-removal pathway.

349 retains study MAG labels, existing domain mappings and all unselected taxon alternatives. The study's GTDB R214 analysis provenance is not the release of the present crosswalk. Genus correspondence does not identify exact MAG assemblies or prove the proposed electron-transfer/auxiliary roles.

424 retains source-specific dehalogenation and uncertain partner roles, Clostridium alternatives, the historical c13s5 correction chain and supplementary-reference failures. A historical note that grounding was not asserted remains historical, not a new biological claim.

Term validation literally reports Validation passed without a reported assertion denominator. Strict successor admission and final integration tests are separate follow-up checks; no prior scientific issue is closed by this diagnostic.
